title: Your AI is a yes-man. Here's the real fix.
description:
Ask an AI if your plan is smart and it makes the case it's brilliant. Ask the same model why that exact plan is a mistake and it argues that just as confidently. It's not lying, it was trained to be agreeable, so a single pass just completes whatever framing you hand it. One answer is structurally a yes-man.

The fix isn't a better prompt. It's independent agents: one set researches the idea, a separate set tries to break it, hunt the flaw, attack the proof, stress-test the thesis, and loop until nothing breaks. Independent agents arguing until the idea holds.
